scope: Read-only inspection of this repository (including ignored account filenames), its course price_history.json, and accessible public professor repositories. No access to private course hosts or brokerage accounts was attempted.
identity_evidence: conid_verification.json; official IBKR product search and security definitions; US / NYSE / USD common stock

production_requirements.all_entries: Authoritative completed-session cash, equity and a complete position inventory, with account date and source. Absence of a positions file is not evidence of an empty account.
production_requirements.cash_start: An explicitly confirmed flat account needs no invented cost basis or option marks. Cash, equity, existing orders and completeness must still reconcile.
production_requirements.covered_call: At least 100 unencumbered actual shares and actual per-share cost basis; existing short calls and pending commitments checked.
production_requirements.existing_short_options: Actual strike, expiry, multiplier/deliverable and closing mark to reconcile NAV and collateral. A missing mark is not zero.
production_requirements.order_resolution: Current pending orders are read from both identical order paths. Resolved IDs/fills or equivalent authoritative reconciled state are needed where relevant; no historical fill is inferred. Producer must finish its prior-session update before planning.

resolved_independently: Four static identifiers are validated locally against retained IBKR evidence; no nightly IBKR login. Conflicting course mappings are rejected. Unconfirmed course enrollment does not invalidate an explicit numerical stock identity or JSON proposal.
remaining_professor_dependencies: Supply the authoritative starting/end-of-session Sanji account and native schema/sample or an approved read-only adapter contract, including confirmation that the inventory is complete.
Specify account update-complete timing and order/fill reconciliation interface.
Confirm BAC/KO/PFE/F enrollment and required contract-open prices in Robin before claiming executable course fills. Identity verification alone does not establish coverage.
Enable resolver outputs only when course execution/performance is required; the documented inactive resolver does not prevent JSON generation.
submission_status: Not submitted. Production order generation remains blocked without authoritative account state. Demonstration proposals are separately labeled and are not production orders.
